question: Estimate annual two-wheeler sales potential in a typical state — say Rajasthan.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total 2W sales: motorcycles + scooters + mopeds + EV 2W? All.
Annual, Rajasthan state? Yes (~7.5 crore population).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: State population × per-capita 2W sales × state-specific tilt.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian annual 2W sales FY26: ~190 lakh units (19M).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Rajasthan 2W sales share: ~6.5% of national = 19M × 0.065 = ~12.3 lakh units/year.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: slightly above average (rural + Tier 2 dominant, 2W preferred over cars).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Hero MotoCorp (commuter dominance in N/NW India)

calculationFlow: Indian annual 2W sales FY26: ~190 lakh units (19M).
Rajasthan 2W ownership index: slightly above average (rural + Tier 2 dominant, 2W preferred over cars).
Rajasthan 2W sales share: ~6.5% of national = 19M × 0.065 = ~12.3 lakh units/year.
- Hero MotoCorp (commuter dominance in N/NW India): ~36% = 4.4L.
